meta.title: Navcar Shipping | Ocean Container Freight
meta.description: From FCL and LCL container shipping to customs clearance, we manage every step of your imports and exports through a single point of contact.

hero.title: Your cargo, safely delivered to ports around the world.
hero.text: From FCL and LCL container shipping to customs clearance, we manage every step of your imports and exports through a single point of contact.
hero.artLabel: Stylised illustration of a container ship and route lines

about.title: Trust at sea, transparency on land
about.text: Navcar Shipping is a dependable logistics partner for importers and exporters, with scheduled sailings from Türkiye's leading ports to the Gulf, Europe and the Far East. We follow every shipment as if it were our own and keep our customers informed throughout the journey.

values.title: On-Time Delivery
values.text: We stick to planned transit times and flag any risk of delay in advance.

values.title: Transparent Pricing
values.text: Ocean freight and additional charges are shared clearly from the start.

values.title: End-to-End Tracking
values.text: You stay informed at every stage, from loading to final delivery.

items.title: FCL Container Shipping
items.text: We carry your full container loads in 20' and 40' containers to destinations worldwide.

items.title: LCL Consolidated Shipping
items.text: We offer economical consolidated solutions for cargo that does not fill a container.

items.title: Import & Export Consulting
items.text: We support you with regulations, documentation and process planning.

items.title: Customs & Documentation
items.text: We speed up your paperwork together with our customs brokerage partners.

items.title: Reefer (Refrigerated) Shipping
items.text: We move temperature-controlled cargo without breaking the cold chain.

items.title: Door-to-Door Delivery
items.text: With port-linked inland transport, we bring your cargo right to your address.
